rows.text: The SIA Group pledged to achieve net zero carbon emissions by 2050.

rows.text: SIA will be the launch operator of the A350F, which will burn up to 40% less fuel than our current freighters, reducing carbon emissions by 400,000 tonnes annually.

rows.text: The pilot is also expected to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by about 2,500 tonnes.

rows.text: We launched the SIA Group’s Voluntary Carbon Offset Programme in June 2021, giving our passenger and cargo customers an opportunity to purchase quality carbon offsets and mitigate their carbon footprint.

rows.text: We are a member of Star Alliance, the International Air Transport Association (IATA), the Association of Asia Pacific Airlines (AAPA), the Sustainable Aviation Fuel Users Group (SAFUG), and the Singapore Institute of Directors (SID), among other groups.

rows.text: Singapore Airlines is committed to operating new generation aircraft to provide greater comfort, drive operating efficiency, and lower carbon emissions.
rows.source_sentence: This is in line with our commitment to operate new generation aircraft that provide greater comfort and innovative products to our customers, further drive operating efficiency, and support ongoing efforts to materially lower our carbon emissions.

rows.text: Singapore Airlines ordered seven Airbus A350F freighters, which burn up to 40% less fuel compared to Boeing 747-400F aircraft, reducing carbon emissions by around 400,000 tonnes annually.
rows.source_sentence: The A350Fs will replace SIA’s seven Boeing 747-400F freighters, making SIA the first airline to operate this new generation widebody freighter aircraft when deliveries begin in the fourth quarter of 2025. Powered by Rolls-Royce Trent XWB-97 engines, the A350F burns up to 40% less fuel on similar missions as compared to the Boeing 747-400F aircraft, reducing SIA’s carbon emissions by around 400,000 tonnes annually.

rows.text: Singapore Airlines aims to achieve net zero carbon emissions by 2050.

rows.text: Singapore Airlines installed 20,000 solar panels generating 10,200MWh of clean energy annually, offsetting 4,300 tonnes of CO2 emissions.
rows.source_sentence: February 2020 – Installs 20,000 solar panels at SIA’s Airline House, SIA Training Centre, TechSQ, five of SIAEC’s hangars and its Engine Test Facility, which generates 10,200MWh of clean energy annually, equivalent to offsetting 4,300 tonnes of CO2 emissions in a year

rows.text: Singapore Airlines partnered with CAAS and Temasek to supply 1.25 million litres of neat SAF for Singapore’s first sustainable aviation fuel pilot.

rows.text: Singapore Airlines launched SAF credits to accelerate the adoption of sustainable aviation fuel.
rows.source_sentence: June 2022 – Announces the launch of SAF credits in July 2022, in partnership with CAAS and Temasek, to accelerate and scale up the collective adoption of sustainable aviation fuel
